queries:
SELECT observstation, CAST(COUNT(telescregistry) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(telescregistry) FROM telescopes) AS share
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY COUNT(telescregistry) DESC, observstation
LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation;
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM telescopes) AS share_pct
FROM telescopes
WHERE equipstatus = 'Operational';
SELECT t.equipstatus,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count,
       100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.telescregistry) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT t.telescregistry)) OVER () AS share_pct
FROM telescopes t
JOIN signals s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
GROUP BY t.equipstatus;
SELECT t.observstation, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS share_pct
FROM signals s
JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
GROUP BY t.observstation
